title: Completed tensor extension of a normalized completion comparison
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y with l invertible in every residue field. For any PodCompletionReindex D satisfying its Laws, there exists a PodCompletedTensorReindex T over that same D satisfying all its Laws: forward and reverse strict tensor generators, strict-tower naturality, derived naturality, the full two-coordinate Roos Model equation, and equality with the specified canonical completed pullback/tensor comparison. No ambient completeness or boundedness condition is added to D. Definitions: [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-tensor-normalization].

source.place: Steps 1 and 5, expanded in parent node proof: Completed tensor extension of a normalized completion comparison.

proof.text: The completeness clause of D makes its ordinary-to-completed comparison invertible on each constructible input. Transport constructibility back along this isomorphism from the existing constructible completed pullback.

Use the strict-tower construction for the tower component. Conjugate the existing natural canonical completed pullback/tensor isomorphism by the ordinary-to-completed isomorphism on the tensor and both factors. This constructs the derived tensor component, proves its naturality, and proves Canonical by the inverse identity in the product category.

Apply the inverse tower map to the forward generator identity and use hom_inv_id to prove InverseGenerators. The normalized Roos comparison lemma gives Model. Assemble these results with forward generators, tower naturality, derived naturality and Canonical into Laws.

lean.statement:
theorem podReindexingTensorConstruction
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D) :
    ∃ T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D,
      PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T
